faq.wenzeTiiNdakuWtnEstUne: WENZE TII NDAKU (WTN) is a Congolese digital marketplace that connects sellers and buyers on a single secure platform. You can buy beauty products, clothing, accessories, tech products and much more.
faq.wtnOpRePrincipalementEnR: WTN operates mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), in Kinshasa and Lubumbashi, with plans to expand across Africa and internationally.
faq.nonWtnEstUnePlateformeInterm: No. WTN is an intermediary platform. Products are sold by independent sellers registered on the platform. WTN only manages transactions on the platform and delivery operations.

faq.leDLaiDPendDu: Delivery time depends on the seller, product availability and the delivery city. We aim to deliver within 5 days.

faq.lesPaiementsSontLibRS: Payments are released after delivery is confirmed and the claim period has ended. Payouts are made monthly according to our internal policy.
faq.ilEstInterditDeVendreDes: It is forbidden to sell illegal, counterfeit, expired or dangerous products. WTN reserves the right to suspend any account in violation.
faq.vosDonnEsPersonnellesSontProt: Your personal data is protected in line with international digital security standards.

faq.ouiEnCasDeFraudeNon: Yes, in case of fraud, breach of the terms and conditions, or abusive behavior.

returns.laPrSentePolitiqueDeRetour: This Return and Refund Policy governs the conditions that apply to products purchased on the WENZE TII NDAKU (WTN) platform.
returns.wtnAgitExclusivementEnQualitDe: WTN acts solely as an intermediary platform (marketplace) connecting independent sellers and buyers. The products sold are offered and shipped by third-party sellers registered on the platform.
returns.leClientDisposeDUnD: The customer has seven (7) calendar days from the date the product is received to submit a return request through their user account.
returns.touteDemandeEffectuEAuDel: Any request made after this period may be refused, except in justified exceptional cases.
returns.unProduitPeutTreRetournUniquement: A product may only be returned in the following cases:
returns.produitNonConformeLaDescriptionPubli: - Product not matching the published description
returns.leProduitDoitTreNonUtilis: The product must be unused, in its original condition, returned in its original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase.
returns.saufDFautAvRLes: Unless there is a proven defect, the following products cannot be returned:
returns.n2LeMailDoitContenirLe: 2. The email must include the registered customer’s name and an identity document.
returns.n3LaCopieDeLaConfirmation: 3. A copy of the order confirmation.
returns.n4DCrivezLeMotifDu: 4. Describe the reason for the return clearly and in detail.
returns.laDemandeSeraExaminEPar: The request will be reviewed by the WTN team together with the seller concerned.
returns.leRemboursementSeraEffectuViaLe: - The refund will be made using the original payment method where possible.
returns.leDLaiDeRemboursementPeut: - Refunds may take between 5 and 14 business days.
returns.unRemplacementUnAvoirOuUn: A replacement, store credit or partial refund may be offered depending on the case.
returns.laChargeDuVendeurSiLe: - Paid by the seller if the product is defective or incorrect.
returns.laChargeDuClientSiLe: - Paid by the customer if the return is due to a change of mind (if accepted).
returns.wtnAgitEnQualitDInterm: WTN acts as a technical intermediary. The seller is responsible for the quality and conformity of the products.
returns.wtnSeRServeLeDroit: WTN reserves the right to suspend a seller in case of repeated abuse, or to refuse clearly abusive requests.
returns.enCasDeDSaccordWtn: In case of disagreement, WTN will carry out an internal mediation procedure.
returns.dFautDAccordLeLitige: If no agreement is reached, the dispute may be brought before the competent courts in accordance with the laws applicable in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
returns.wtnSeRServeLeDroit2: WTN reserves the right to modify this policy at any time to ensure legal compliance and the proper operation of the platform.
